items.text: James "Jim" Geldermann is a small business owner and software developer. He is president of a software and development company with more than 40 years of information technology and software design experience. He says he has been a digital ministry leader at Our Lady of Perpetual Help Church, a hospice volunteer, and a board member of First Step House and the Illinois Cemetery Oversight Board.
